tolerance.basis: Measured same-seed, same-data GPU reruns reproduced validation IC to four decimals (P0-A, 17_p0_a_daily_result.md). P4-B0 stores train_loss and val_ic rounded to 5 decimals. P4-B0 seed-to-seed SD at the three shared refits: val_ic about 0.02, train_loss about 0.0004 (epochs 1-3), val_loss about 0.0009, oos_pred_std about 56% relative. Non-deterministic CUDA kernels (no cudnn.deterministic) can amplify differences with steps, so later epochs get a wider band. Tolerances sit far below seed-to-seed variation, because a harness divergence (different rows, labels or RNG draws) would look like a different seed, and far above the measured rerun band.

outcomes.PARITY_PASS: metadata exact; all tier-1 and tier-2 per-cell bounds and pooled bounds hold
outcomes.PARITY_PASS_WITH_LATE_DRIFT: metadata exact; all tier-1 bounds hold; pooled tier-2 bounds hold; per-cell tier-2 bounds exceeded in <= 10% of the 108 cell-epochs, all at epochs >= 6

tolerance.excluded_from_anchor: oos_ic (outcome channel; embargoed until Stage 3). Its epoch-1..15 parity is reported after Stage 3 as a secondary check.
